notes.title: 2017.10.17公告(2017.10.17 announcement)
notes.notes:
亲爱的各位朋友，更新内容如下，请完全退出并重新运行游戏确保正常升级：
(1)修正开启卡包时显示能够得到的卡牌数目过低的错误。
(2)增加家族内卡牌捐赠功能，捐赠具体数目规则请在游戏主页进入“竞技模式”的左侧单击信息按钮查看，不同的竞技场阶数是不同的。
(3)具体捐赠请进入家族内实行，同时，捐赠给别人卡牌也有一定的金币奖励，不同品质的卡牌奖励金币数目也不同哦！
(4)全球同服家族卡牌捐赠功能比我想象中更加复杂，开发耗时很久，但为了让大家体验到一些不一样的东西，我也是拼了，这次我们就更新一个功能，祝大家游戏愉快！


Dear friends，updates are as follows,please completely quit game and rerun the game to ensure upgrades:
(1)when open Packs,The number of cards Contains shows error,repaired.
(2)Clans Cards donation,donation rules please enter "Player VS Player Mode" and see left,click info button to view,every level arena has a different rule.
(3)donation is in clans,and when donate to others ,you can get some gold reward according to card quality!
(4)As a global service, real-time combat Strategy Role-Playing online games,clans cards donation very complex in programming,It takes a long time to develop,but in order to let us experience something different,I tried my best!
This time we update one function,wish you happy in game!

notes.title: 2017.9.30公告（2017.9.30 announcement）
notes.notes:
亲爱的各位朋友，更新内容如下，请完全退出并重新运行游戏确保正常升级：
(1)剧情模式第二季正式推出。
(2)推出国庆/中秋双节的商店节假日特惠礼包，持续时间：8天，感谢大家支持。
(3)调整治疗术/群疗术的整体治疗效果，请大家亲自体验。
(4)家族增加成员在线提示。
(5)新增家族切磋，家族内2个成员之间可以切磋，无论输赢，每天的前三次切磋将会有金币的奖励，具体规则加入家族后参看。


Dear friends，updates are as follows,please completely quit game and rerun the game to ensure upgrades:
(1)Release story mode ,Season 2.
(2)National Day/Mid-Autumn Festival holiday Special package, duration: 8 days,Thank you for your support.
(3)Adjust Skill "Therapy/Group therapy", Please experience it yourself.
(4)Family member online tips.
(5)Add Family members friendly battle,every day first three battles will be rewarded with gold.

notes.title: 欢迎大家下载游戏体验(Welcome to download the game)
notes.notes:
大家好：
《冒险之路》正式发布了，与此同时，我也开始了对游戏不断更新的旅程。每次更新以及下次更新的内容我都会在游戏公告中及时写出。
游戏中有不尽如人意的地方，还请大家海涵，在我力所能及的范围内，我都会不断改进，多谢，现在，我要继续去开发本游戏的更新内容了。


hello,every one:
《Adventure Road》was officially released,At the same time,I've also started a journey to update the game.Every update and the next update will be written in the game announcement.
There are some unsatisfactory places in the game, please be tolerant,within my power,I will continue to improve,thanks a lot,now, I'm going to continue developing this game's update content.
